findings.label: Per-site injection instead of one chokepoint
findings.detail: withOmniRouteTier is applied at four sites (getState, createTask handoff, updateTaskApiHandlerIfNeeded, Task.getCondensingApiHandler). Every current task-handler path is covered, but a future buildApiHandler call site can skip it with no failing test. Consider a guard test or a single provider-level builder.

findings.label: Enhancement profile drops the tier
findings.detail: messageEnhancer uses the saved enhancementApiConfigId profile as-is; since saveConfig now strips omniRouteTier, a dedicated OmniRoute enhancement profile sends no X-OmniRoute-Tier. Wrap configToUse in withOmniRouteTier if enhancement should honor the ceiling.

findings.label: Mid-task tier change not applied
findings.detail: Pre-existing: a running task keeps the tier it was built with until a mode/profile switch rebuilds the handler. This is relevant to the user's paid-provider fallback report; mention it or rebuild on tier change.
